manageYourAccountSchedulingAndThisSiteS: Manage your account, scheduling and this site''s display preferences.
configureOperatorOrderAndExportedSchedul: Configure operator order and exported schedules.
exportOperatorsInTheSameOrderShownIn: Export operators in the same order shown in the schedule. Enabling this can make MAA take longer to fill rooms.
onlyAllowsMaaToAdjustOperatorOrderInside: Only allows MAA to adjust operator order inside the same facility when replacing a schedule. Off by default.
chooseOneShiftOrAllShiftsAllShift: Choose one shift or all shifts. All-shift export is currently under maintenance.
adjustAppearanceViewSwitchingAndBrowsing: Adjust appearance, view switching and browsing behavior.
chooseDayOrNightModeForThisSite: Choose day or night mode for this site. Endfield keeps its own preference.
chooseButtonsOrADropdownForOverviewAnd: Choose buttons or a dropdown for overview and list.
disableThisToTuneOverviewListAndShift: Disable this to tune overview/list and shift switching separately.
chooseButtonsOrADropdownForSwitchingBetw: Choose buttons or a dropdown for switching between shifts.
infiniteScrollOrClickAfterTenResults: Infinite scroll or click after ten results.
highlightOperatorsWithNoUnlockedInfrastr: Highlight operators with no unlocked infrastructure skill matching a facility in the current layout. Off by default.
chooseTheToolsAndActionButtonsShownIn: Choose the tools and action buttons shown in the workspace.
showTheButtonForSimulatingHigherOperator: Show the button for simulating higher operator levels.
showTheButtonForOpeningTheManualSchedule: Show the button for opening the manual schedule editor.
mowerScheduleImportAndExportInManualSche: Mower schedule import and export in manual scheduling. Off by default.
showIssueAndPerformanceFeedbackActions: Show issue and performance feedback actions.
showClosureInTheCornerOfThePage: Show Closure in the corner of the page. You can still open the assistant from the sidebar when this is off.
chooseWhichImagesAndLanguageResourcesToL: Choose which images and language resources to load.
whenOffEnglishGameDataIsNotRequested: Preload game text for your selected language. When off, text loads as you open a feature. All languages remain available.
whenOffShowNamesWithoutLoadingPortraits: When off, show names without loading portraits.
clearsArknightsSchedulesDraftsBoxLayoutD: Clears Arknights schedules, drafts, BOX/layout data, settings and browser cache. Endfield data is not affected.
clearArknightsLocalDataAndBrowserCacheEn: Clear Arknights local data and browser cache? Endfield data will be kept.
